Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We don’t just develop embedded software — we engineer intelligence into products. The Embedded Competence Center at NTT DATA Romania brings together experts in embedded systems, firmware development, and hardware–software integration, delivering robust and high-performance solutions for complex, safety-critical environments. With strong expertise in C/C++, AUTOSAR, real-time operating systems, and communication protocols, we design scalable embedded architectures, integrate software seamlessly with hardware, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Across the industries we support — from Automotive and Industrial Automation to Smart Devices and IoT — we transform reliable embedded technology into a foundation for innovative, dependable products.
As a Sample Test Engineer, you will be responsible for testing and validating different automotive electronic samples and configurations.You will work closely with the Sample Manager, System Integration and Development teams, supporting the validation of samples before they are delivered for internal use or to customers. The position is open toboth entry-level and experienced candidates. Recent graduates with a technical background will have the opportunity to develop hands-on experience in automotive electronics, testing and validation, while experienced candidates can build on their existing expertise and take on responsibilities aligned with their technical background and level of experience.
 Location: Craiova, Romania – minimum 80% on-site
 Experience level: Junior / Entry Level / Mid Level
 What You'll Be Doing
Perform functional testing and validation of automotive electronic samples.
Prepare and configure test setups according to defined test procedures.
Perform software flashing and configuration of the samples under test.
Execute automated tests using dSPACE AutomationDesk, based on already developed test scripts.
Monitor test execution and identify potential errors or unexpected behavior.
Perform basic electrical and parametric measurements.
Analyze test results and detected errors with support from experienced engineers.
Document and report test results according to project requirements.
Collaborate with Sample Management, System Integration and Development teams to ensure the quality of delivered samples.
Follow established testing procedures and contribute to improving test and validation activities.
 What You'll Bring Along
The position is open to both entry-level and experienced candidates. Previous professional experience in automotive testing, electronics, embedded systems or similar areas is considered an advantage, but is not mandatory.
Completed Bachelor's degree or technical university studies in a relevant field, such as:Electronics / Applied Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Automation and Applied Informatics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Automotive Engineering or another related technical field.
Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
Ability to understand electrical schematics and perform basic electrical measurements is considered an advantage.
Basic knowledge of testing equipment, laboratory equipment or embedded systems is considered an advantage.
Any academic or practical exposure to dSPACE, AutomationDesk, HIL testing, CAN communication or software flashing tools is a plus, but not mandatory.
Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
Willingness to learn and work with automotive testing tools and technologies.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Good command of English.
